name: Ios
description: 适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的专业能力扩展插件，提供免配置一键安装与高效辅助支持。
descriptionEn: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: a live iOS Simulator — and a USB-connected iPhone — inside the conversation. 22 agent tools for booting, building, driving the UI by accessibility identity, OCR text or list rows, plus a streaming sidebar panel you can tap and drag on.
author: MingLin
